question: Where was Asia's longest double-decker flyover inaugurated in October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On **October 5, 2024**, Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** inaugurated **Asia's longest double-decker flyover** in **Nagpur**, **Maharashtra**.
 
• The flyover, known as the **Pardi Flyover**, spans a length of approximately **5.3 kilometers**, setting a new benchmark for urban infrastructure in **India** and across the continent.
 
• This massive project was developed as a joint venture between the **National Highways Authority of India (NHAI)** and the **Maharashtra Metro Rail Corporation (Maha Metro)**.
 
• The structure is located on **National Highway 53 (NH-53)** and is designed to decongest the heavily crowded **Pardi**, **Kapsi**, and **HB Town** areas of **Nagpur**.
